method: Actual dev-browser providers and module Workers. A persistent Windows CPU-rate controller owns only a new browser tree. The queried416 hard cap is unchanged. Actual Worker OS PID/TID and job membership are proven before retained work. Three200M arithmetic loops per leg verify scheduled CPU duty with whole-job user+kernel accounting divided by summed actual loop wall duration; .20 is accounting tolerance alongside the fixed cap. Relative wall ratios are descriptive, with no6xthroughput or physical-core equivalence claim. Five alternating baseline/candidate repetitions per viewport and CPU condition. Startup, first replies, warm legal replies and host load remain separate. Phone viewport and touch are emulated. No physical-phone or production-runtime claim.

probeLegs.interpretation: Whole-job scheduled CPU time divided by actual arithmetic-loop wall time. Other browser CPU is included, never subtracted. This is an observed duty estimate, not a frequency, physical-core, relative wall-speed or device-equivalence claim; 100ns counter units do not establish 100ns resolution.
